## What this changes

<!-- One or two sentences. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] New app entry
- [ ] New report on an existing app
- [ ] Correction to existing data
- [ ] Prose or layout change
- [ ] Tooling or CI

## If you are adding or changing a report

- [ ] I tested this myself on a real device. I am not submitting second-hand or generated information.
- [ ] `date` is the date I actually tested, and it is not in the future.
- [ ] `build` is the exact GrapheneOS release I was running.
- [ ] `country` is where the app was used, not where I live.
- [ ] I set `blocked_reason` only if I know why it failed. Otherwise I left it as `unknown`.

## Checklist

- [ ] `./dev` builds locally with no errors
- [ ] `uv run scripts/validate.py` passes
- [ ] No other entries were modified
